Post 1
📉 Barely a scratch on the surface. ASX 200 slipped just 9.4pts to 8,911.40 (-0.11%) Wed, but a new 20-day low tells a quieter story of fading momentum — down 0.75% over five days, 4.14% off 52-week highs. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔺 Energy +1.73% and Materials +1.51% were the only real bright spots Wed. Health Care led the selling at -1.50%, Financials dropped -1.02%, Consumer Discretionary -1.14%. A defensive session with no clear conviction. #ASX #energy #materials

Post 3
⛏️ Austal surged +7.13% to AUD 4.66 — standout mover of the session. Defence demand driving the re-rating. Meanwhile SEK cratered -5.61% to AUD 12.80, its worst day in months as labour market sentiment sours. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold holding firm at AUD 6,145.94/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7237. Silver at AUD 93.14/oz, Platinum AUD 2,568.17/oz. Metals bid underpinning Materials sector strength today — watch gold if the AUD softens further. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits 4.14% below 52-week highs with momentum fading. The line in the sand is 8,900 — a clean break below opens a deeper pullback. Does Materials strength hold if global growth fears return? Drop your level below. #ASX #ausbiz #trading
